task1.title: Request for a Reference
task1.prompt: You are applying for a job and need a reference from your previous employer. Write a letter to your former employer requesting a reference. In your letter, explain the job you are applying for, why you need the reference, and provide any details that might help the employer write the reference. Make sure to be polite and professional.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In the modern world, the use of technology has transformed the way we communicate. Some people believe that technology has improved communication, while others argue that it has created barriers. Discuss both views and give your opinion on the impact of technology on communication. Support your arguments with relevant examples.
